_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: With the score moving ±2+ points in only 4% of recent 12h windows and conflicting macro signals (VIX 68 vs early-recovery momentum), this is a coil where HOLD is the statistically honest call until either ETF flows recover or VIX breaks down.
next_move.brains_agree: No — the analyst calls HOLD with medium conviction while the narrative implies a bullish reversal; the split is fundamental on whether the analog is current or forward-looking.
next_move.confirmed_if: ETF flows turn positive and VIX drops below 40, shifting toward Disbelief
next_move.invalidated_if: LONG_AGGRESSIVE triggered prematurely without flow confirmation, or score breaks below 39 into Denial on macro deterioration
